assumptions: Two pending rows, one coordinator, two database marker commits, and a stable total order. Unrelated prompt/result availability is independent of the complete inline settlement metadata projection.

The selected immutable row ID, original organization/user, model, provider job ID, complete metadata and creation time are retained. Persisted update receipts are separate from full-payload hydration; missing rows cannot claim a receipt.

Real PGlite tests exercise the whole coordinator loop, unavailable prompts, provider probe failures, complete metadata preservation, later-row progress and deletion before the update receipt. Live provider availability, PostgreSQL lock/refinement proof, concurrent coordinators, financial settlement arithmetic and stale status fencing are outside this model.

Progress requires both original pending rows to remain present, weakly fair selection/provider resolution/database writes and two available attempts. It does not promise provider success, financial completion or an elapsed deadline.
